issue.title: bob-mac-capture master CI: testHighlightsTaskFallbackShowKeepsTabsAndBannerUntilLibraryRestores expects query "small" but the model restores "small_reading" (since 62302372)
issue.description:
Found by the bob-cli-pq land agent while verifying the epic's Mac tests (bob-cli-pq.6 note #3 first reported the compile half). Not caused by bob-cli-pq: both failures come from bob-mac-capture 62302372 ("feat(highlights): open reading task headlessly via Ctrl+Return", agent 1fm, no bead). bob-mac-capture master CI has been red on every push since then (runs 45227361015, 45234472802, 45250101853).

1. **Compile half (fixed during the bob-cli-pq landing).** Tests/BobMacCaptureTests/RefsPanelModelTests.swift:2916 and :2935 used `XCTAssertEqual(await first.value, …)`, which the macOS 26 toolchain rejects ("'async' property access in an autoclosure that does not support concurrency"). That stopped the whole test target from compiling. The bob-cli-pq landing commit binds `let firstResult = await first.value` first.

2. **Remaining true failure.** With the compile fix, exact-SHA run https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-mac-capture/actions/runs/45255052132 (snapshot 2557ce113fe17f9c700538aba3f1ac72f0bfc982) executed 5157 tests with 1 skipped and exactly 1 failure:
   `RefsPanelModelTests.testHighlightsTaskFallbackShowKeepsTabsAndBannerUntilLibraryRestores`. At RefsPanelModelTests.swift:2967, `XCTAssertEqual failed: ("small_reading") is not equal to ("small")`.
   The test calls `setQuery("small_reading")`, opens the highlightsTaskFallback presentation (which clears the query), then reopens `.library` and expects the restored query to be `"small"`. The model restores the query it saved, `"small_reading"`. The expectation looks like a copy error. Confirm the intended restore semantics in RefsPanelModel.prepareForPresentation before changing the test or the model. Bundle, signature, launch smoke, and install gates are skipped until Test passes.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic value mismatch ("small_reading" vs "small") from a fixed setQuery input with no timing in the asserted path; master CI has failed since 62302372 on every run (first at compile, now at this assertion).

issue.creation_reason: bob-mac-capture master CI has failed on every push since 62302372; the bob-cli-pq landing fixed the compile half, and one deterministic assertion still fails and skips the bundle, launch, and install gates.
